exposure: Initiation of headache earlier than 5 days postpartum
cohort: A total of 102 patients experiencing postpartum headache who underwent brain magnetic resonance imaging study.
finding: Abnormal brain magnetic resonance imaging findings were observed in 41.2% of patients with postpartum headache, with sinusitis, PRES, CVT, and SAH being the most common findings.
cross-section timing: Postpartum, with analysis of headaches initiating earlier than 5 days postpartum.
